question: We perform the determination of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) to diagnose prostate cancer in adolescents and healthy elderly, without benign prostatic hyperplasia:

options.opa: PSA sensitivity in adolescents will be higher than in the elderly.
options.opb: The specificity of PSA in adolescents will be lower than in the elderly.
options.opc: The internal validity of PSA in healthy adolescents or elderly will not change.
options.opd: The positive predictive value of PSA in adolescents will be higher than in the elderly.
